title: Implement a structured verifier adapter
prompt: Wrap a controlled/mock verifier callback into structured outcomes. True means valid, False means counterexample; TimeoutError/SyntaxError/other exceptions map to timeout/compile_error/internal_error. Return status, candidate SHA256, and a bounded diagnostic. No untrusted code is executed by this adapter.
